body:
## RVL
**A custom modpack for myself from myself.**

But if you're interested and want to download it, feel free to download it.
And thank you for downloading it as well.

## List

<details>
<summary>List of changes I made inside it</summary>
  
~~~~
General
Render Distance: 10
Max Shadow Distance: off
Simulation Distance: 8
GUI Scale: 2x

Quality
Clouds: off
Weather: Fancy
Mipmap levels: 2x

Render
Single Fog: off

Extras
Show FPS: on

Xaero's Minimap -> entity Radar Settings 
Display Radar: off

XaeroPlus
Minimap FPS Limiter: on

Zoomify
Initial Zoom: 2x
Zoom In Time: 0.8

Mob Health Bar
Type: 7
Y position: -10
Damaged: on
Name: off
~~~~

</details>
